comment: CPUSkinning (src/title/thp8_skin_native.c): the six headers tools/symskin.py generates ON THE PLAYER'S PC from the player's own SPU lift (src/spu_gen/job_skin/spu_recomp.c). Nothing generated ships: the generator does. A header that does not hash to these values means this lift is not the pinned one and the lifted CPUSkinning job runs instead.
